final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_rate_delta FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_delta) AS overall_avg_rate_delta FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.avg_rebate, s1.avg_rate_delta, s1.avg_rate_delta - s2.overall_avg_rate_delta AS rate_delta_from_overall FROM step1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg_rate_delta IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_rate_delta > s2.overall_avg_rate_delta) SELECT AVG(avg_rebate), AVG(avg_rate_delta), AVG(rate_delta_from_overall) FROM step3
